answer: A pre-written answer bank as a result goes stale within one epoch, and reusing one text across 74 aliases trips the duplicate check at the terrace gate. The challenge words rotate once mid-epoch from a comet seed nobody controls, and the answer is judged against the words it was submitted under. The trellis receipt proves which words were live for that identity, and the audit replays it against the seed. The deposit is 22 dollars a seat. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
